en.headline: Stephen Curry visits Tuen Mun school on first Hong Kong trip in a decade
en.dek: The four-time NBA champion spoke with students at Shun Tak Fraternal Association Leung Kau Kui College and later appeared at a Li-Ning store in Tsim Sha Tsui.
body: NBA star Stephen Curry made a brief visit to Hong Kong on Monday, his first in ten years, and spent time with students at a secondary school in Tuen Mun.

Curry arrived at Shun Tak Fraternal Association Leung Kau Kui College to cheers from pupils and onlookers. He watched a school game, took shots with students and spoke about dealing with self-doubt and pressure, saying hard work and accepting failure had been part of his path to four championships.
Later he appeared at Li-Ning’s flagship store in Tsim Sha Tsui, drawing crowds for a limited Hong Kong capsule collection released as part of his China tour.

zh.headline: Stephen Curry十年後再訪港 到屯門中學與學生交流
zh.dek: 四屆NBA總冠軍周一到訪順德聯誼總會梁銶琚中學，其後在尖沙嘴李寧專門店亮相，吸引大批球迷。
body: NBA球星Stephen Curry周一短暫訪港，距離上次來港已有十年。
他到屯門順德聯誼總會梁銶琚中學與師生交流，觀看校隊比賽並與學生一同投籃，分享如何面對自我懷疑及外界壓力，指努力及接受失敗是他奪得四屆總冠軍的過程一部分。
其後他現身尖沙嘴李寧專門店，配合中國巡演推出的香港限定聯乘系列吸引大批球迷圍觀。
